summary: @servicetitan/table preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes hidden obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is itself variable-name-obfuscated and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and uses execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (string array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`, tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that is NOT declared in package.json `files` (which lists only `dist` and `src`) yet ships in the tarball. A React table UI library has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime; fetching Bun and using it to execute an undeclared, heavily obfuscated sibling script during preinstall is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern — the payload runs on `npm install` and is deliberately shaped to evade Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
